title: Orchestrator hardening: wire the task gate, make review precise, add deep rounds / clean-round completion / PR-comment handling / adaptive models

AC1.note: src/flow/task-gate.test.ts drives a flow to completion with an open task and asserts the fifth gate fails; taskGateStatus() wired into service.ts complete().

AC2.note: Opt-in via FlowState.gates.tasks written by flow init, not schemaVersion (195/197 packages are already v2, so it cannot discriminate). Pre-existing packages report tasks: skipped; covered by task-gate.test.ts.

AC3.note: skipped passes only with a recorded dispositionReason; enforced in evaluateTaskGate so harness-written state is caught too. Decision and reasoning recorded in journal.md.

AC4.note: Commit cfb4c3b5 touches both src/flow/service.ts and flow-orchestrator/SKILL.md - the gate and the claim removal land together, verifiable on that commit.

AC5.note: findings.json is now an array of pure contract objects validating against review-finding.schema.json and carrying the real reviewer; asserted in round-trip.test.ts.

AC6.note: round-trip.test.ts builds a round-2 reviewer-input with is_fix_round true from a round-1 findings.json alone and validates it; green from both structured and legacy rounds. Non-vacuity pinned by asserting the old shape is still rejected.

AC7.note: Legacy Markdown path retained and exercised over the 11 real packages under .metaproject/reviews/; covered in round-trip.test.ts.

AC8.note: flow task attempt with --outcome started|failed|blocked increments attempts.count and appends to attempts.log through the service layer; src/flow/attempts.test.ts.

AC9.note: attempts.test.ts reloads the package from disk and asserts the persisted count, not an in-process value.

AC10.note: flow-orchestrator/SKILL.md Phase 0 gains a State Resumption Check; Phase 4 reads attempts.count from flow.json rather than from context. Both mirrors updated.

AC12.note: diff over both skill trees reports no differences for every file touched.

AC13.note: typecheck clean; bun test 5423 pass / 18 skip / 0 fail against a 5398/18/0 baseline; test:guards 161/0; check:doc-links 1128 links 0 broken.

AC11 corrected: the premise that FAILED is unreachable is false. src/harness/child/contract.ts parses STATUS: FAILED from external child workers, wired at src/harness/extension/execute.ts:167, and spawn.test.ts:505 asserts a FAILED disposition maps to a failed completion 'never a false completed'. Removing it would delete a tested completion-safety path. The real defect is documentation: the protocol doc says four statuses, the schema carries five. AC11 now requires correcting the doc instead of deleting the enum value; the other three deletions are unchanged.
